messages:
Priya S: Quick flag: Samir K (PM) starts Monday and we need to get core access squared away. I drafted a condensed first-week agenda and a lightweight 30/60/90. Posting here so IT/eng/product can action.

Priya S: ```
Day 1: HR intro, payroll setup, equipment handoff, security brief
Day 2: Engineering onboarding, GitHub org + repo access, local dev setup
Day 3: Product deep-dive, roadmap intro, stakeholder 1:1s
Rest of week: shadowing, join standups, staging access, small starter ticket
30/60/90 summary: 30d = ramp & learn; 60d = own small feature; 90d = lead feature + cross-team sync
Required accounts: Okta, Slack, GitHub (org: redwood-inc), JIRA project & board, VPN, GCP console (read)
```

Priya S: Samir details: samir.khanna@example.com, macOS preferred. Can we prioritize GitHub and Okta so they can clone and run locally by day 2?

Alex M: On it. Looping in @it-support and @devex. If Okta shows pending, IT can re-send. For GH, engineering team can manually invite to the product-pm team.

IT Support: I see an Okta invite sent but not accepted. Re-sent invite at 1718010012. Okta provisioning will trigger VPN and GCP roles after acceptance. If Samir doesn't see it, check spam or accept link.

Devex Bot: Quick GH helper: run this with GH CLI to invite and add to team: ```gh api orgs/redwood-inc/invitations -f invitee_id=$(gh user view samir.khanna --json id -q .id) && gh api orgs/redwood-inc/teams/product-pm/memberships --raw-field role=member -F username=samir.khanna```

IT Support: Manual GitHub invite sent at 1718010035. JIRA groups updated (added to product-pm). VPN profile will appear after Okta sync (~15-30 mins after acceptance).

Elaine H: Payroll note: Samir still needs to complete the tax + direct deposit forms. I re-sent the onboarding packet. Equipment shipping scheduled for tomorrow, ETA two business days.

Samir K: Thanks everyone 5b excited to join! I accepted the Okta invite and filled the equipment form. Small question: who to ping if VPN/profile doesn't appear?

IT Support: Ping this channel or open a ticket at https://redwood.atlassian.net/servicedesk. We'll triage ASAP.

Alex M: Let's have a 30-min sync on Friday to tweak week 1 goals and confirm access. Priya, can you send a calendar invite?

Priya S: Yup, sending now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
